“VCs need to transform. There are patterns
that have been in place for too long. In most
cases, funds are still run by white males.
This means that the observation of new
opportunities just isn’t there.”
- Operator
Our data suggests that this isn’t just conjecture. Funds focusing on industries inherently connected
to the issues of a diverse group of people are more diverse themselves. More than a quarter of
the investors attending Slush 2019 from funds focusing on health, biotech, fintech, medtech and
cleantech were women, compared to less than a seventh from ones focused on gaming.
